svg.title: Pause and resume are scoped controls
svg.desc: Draw pause and resume as labelled controls attached to scopes. Avoid moral color coding that turns operational dispositions into virtue or wrongdoing. Visual distinction: A bounded workload tray with a large pause pair and a stop bar. A temporary operational disposition, not a breached wall or permanent destruction.
